The Typing Lab needs a physical keyboard. You can look around on a phone, but do the lessons and tests on a computer or a tablet with a keyboard.

‹ All workplace drills

10-key number entry

Billing and records work means long columns of numbers. Type each entry and press Enter, keeping your eyes on the screen.

No numeric keypad on your laptop?

Practice on the number row above the letters for now, or plug in a USB numeric keypad if one is available. When you use a keypad, check that Num Lock is on: with Num Lock off, the keypad moves the cursor instead of typing numbers.

Entries

Type each number, then press Enter. Rest your right hand on 4, 5, 6 (feel the bump on 5), use your thumb for 0, and keep your eyes on the screen.

Entry 1 of 15
643058

Index finger: 1 4 7. Middle: 2 5 8. Ring: 3 6 9 and the decimal point. Pinky: Enter. Thumb: 0.

Colors match the keyboard: right index finger, right middle finger, right ring finger, right pinky.
